scope: Proposed roadmap from completed startup diagnostics through dual-arm cutting and later learning. Counts are not time estimates.

items.title: Confirm upgraded RAM and available GPU memory.
Add memory monitoring, bounded runtime and clean shutdown.
Launch Isaac Sim and complete the empty-scene startup check.
Run isolated blade/coupon initial and stationary checks.
Check blade distances/normals using precise reference queries.
Define contact coordinates, signs, weights and margin rules.
Build and check the contact snapshot adapter.
Verify actual native contact-buffer capture and overflow guards.
Generate and verify particle/edge/face contacts on an analytic box.
Check translated/rotated contact-record coordinates on that box.
Resolve force precision with separate geometry and arithmetic checks.
items.progress: Six native analytic fixtures pass under reference version 2. Historical combined gate remains failed and preserved.

items.title: Qualify the real blade's full-surface contact path.
items.progress: Authored-blade contact passes on the full tomato mesh, including force transfer, exact replay and clearing. Longer cuts remain unqualified.
checks: PASS — original blade geometry and finite-surface coverage
PASS — generated contact forces and exact replay

items.title: Verify particle/edge/face force distribution in stationary fixtures.
items.progress: Six native fixtures pass force and diagonal-stiffness scatter, color gating, spectator and algebraic reaction/moment checks. No integration.

items.title: Check dynamic momentum and work on minimal analytic fixtures.
items.progress: Two fresh one-step native fixtures pass: free particle/box recoil, momentum, impulse, discrete work/energy and clear control. Newton-internal coupling only.

items.title: Implement and validate Newton–Isaac/PhysX two-way coupling.
items.progress: Full tomato force feedback passes with a moving probe and the authored blade. Momentum, state feedback and reset/replay checks pass.
checks: PASS — linear/angular balance and exact replay

items.title: Resolve the cohesive material solver/operator needed for cutting.
items.progress: All 47 material patches pass controlled loading on the full mesh. Supported scope: a fixed material frame and tensile loading.
checks: PASS — native force, stiffness and damage history
PASS — loading work and bulk-volume protection
LIMIT — general compression/shear and free-fragment closure remain unqualified

items.title: Validate material response against chosen reference measurements.
items.progress: Pending at your request. The published curve is a provisional reference; independent measurements are still needed.

items.title: Verify damage, separation and post-cut contact on a small coupon.
items.progress: Small interface and solid coupons pass damage, separation, reclosure and replay. Whole-fruit post-cut behavior remains unqualified.
checks: PASS — fracture budget and irreversible failure

items.title: Verify robot, blade and target placement, units and coordinate frames.
items.progress: The original knife is mounted in a separate robot scene using SI units. The ideal fixed joint preserves the checked frames and adds no actuator joint.
checks: PASS — actual 36-joint robot; one active original knife
SCOPE — ideal massless mount; no finger-grasp claim

items.title: Verify target restraint/grasp and collision settings.
items.progress: Fixed support and collision setup pass bounded fixture checks. Support holds a 5 ms gravity probe; long-term settling and cutting loads are later checks.
checks: PASS — 25 support nodes; slice nodes remain free
PASS — collision monitor detects a deliberate impact and clearing

items.title: Check approach, cutting and retreat motions without target contact.
items.progress: Two 8-second offset dry cycles pass approach, stroke and retreat under robot gravity. Minimum blade/target gap is 34.4 mm; blade/board clearance is 6.01 mm.
checks: PASS — rigid mount, bounded speed and tracking
PASS — no monitored forbidden contact forces; exact replay

items.title: Verify reset restores poses, velocities, contacts and material history.
items.progress: Robot rigid reset and target material reset/replay pass. A deliberate generated-contact challenge clears 11,439 blade contacts to zero. Loaded post-cut reset remains untested.
checks: PASS — poses, velocities and both wrench queues
PASS — both target buffers, history and generated contact clearing

items.title: Run a slow, short cut with force, penetration and work logging.
items.progress: Next: implement and check robot-mounted blade force feedback, then run a slow, bounded first cut with force and work logging.

items.title: Verify meaningful separation without unstable or spurious forces.
Check repeatability and sensitivity to time step/contact resolution.
Save a reproducible baseline scene, settings and results.
Integrate the second arm and its grasp/support role.
Verify coordinated motion, mutual collisions and force transfer.
Repeat the controlled cutting baseline with both arms.
Finalize observations, actions, rewards and termination conditions.
Validate repeated resets and scripted baseline episodes.
Run a small training/evaluation pilot before longer experiments.
